title.narrative: Providing High-Quality Education to Ukrainian Refugee Children, “Little Seeds of Hope”

description.narrative:
Located in Bucharest, the JRS Romania Educational Hub offers essential educational services to young minds displaced by the Ukrainian crisis, by specialised Ukrainian staff.
Our primary goal is to consistently provide specific tailored education (uninterrupted education) to 95 Ukrainian refugee children (40 in grade 1 to 5 and 55 in kindergarten – age 3-10) while supporting their mothers in their job-seeking efforts. This assists in the broader objective of integrating Ukrainian refugees into Romanian society. As for the enrolled children, the kindergarten and school isn't merely a routine; it signifies a hope for stability and a commitment to betterment.
This project proposal, spanning from October 2024 to December 2024, aims to provide more than traditional schooling. The hub integrates advanced technology, ensuring a participatory and immersive learning environment. Nevertheless, the real transformation is driven by our tailored curriculum, which accommodates the diverse academic backgrounds and language challenges of the students. Romanian language lessons for all is facilitating the transition to the Romanian schools for the next academic year. English lessons is enriching their educational potential.
Beyond fundamental education like math or Ukrainian language, the hub extends specialized classes in areas such as chess and IT, cultivating logical and problem-solving capabilities. Furthermore, creative workshops in art, music, and craft nurture the children's emotional and intellectual development. Art-therapy classes, psychological support, and logopedy collectively assist early child development by facilitating emotional expression, ensuring mental well-being, and enhancing speech and communication skills.
